next.reason: Amendment 2 (X3.23b-1993, Errata C217) replaced the first sentence, which the standard printed as "An index-name and a data item (other than an index data item) or literal.", so the rule now reads §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.3 GR2 "An index-name and a numeric data item or numeric literal. The occurrence number that corresponds to the value of the index-name is compared to the data item or literal." §2023:8.8.4.2.13 GR2 has the same words: "an index-name and a numeric data item or numeric literal. The occurrence number that corresponds to the value of the index-name is compared to the data item or literal." The amendment removed the one difference the unamended text had (any non-index data item or literal against numeric ones only); the same comparisons are accepted and they compare the same occurrence number.
